result.summary: Do not ship: password changes no longer revoke existing sessions, preserving compromised access.

findings.title: Restore session revocation on password change
findings.body: Updating only password_hash preserves the existing session_secret. An attacker holding a cookie issued before the password change can still access protected routes afterward: AuthMiddleware accepts it at triggarr/web/middleware.py:146–148, and validate_session checks only its signature and age, not the password hash. That access persists until the cookie's 30-day expiry. The reset endpoint's rotation does not protect this password-change path.
findings.recommendation: Restore session_secret rotation alongside the password hash update and reissue the acting user's cookie. Verify the existing password-change rotation and other-device eviction tests.

next_steps: Restore revocation and run the password-change tests in tests/test_auth_routes.py and tests/test_auth_integration.py.
